paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of two novel scrap tolerant Al65Cu10Mg10Si10Zn5 and Al80Cu5Mg5Si5Zn5 high entropy aluminum alloys

evidence.quote: The microstructure and mechanical properties of two novel Al65Cu10Mg10Si10Zn5 and Al80Cu5Mg5Si5Zn5 high entropy aluminum alloys were studied.
